violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Equipment moved to warewashing area to be washed, rinsed, and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2026
The gasket of the reach-in cooler was observed in poor repair (torn/not tightly fitting). The equipment must be in good repair and proper adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

The following was observed of non-food contact surfaces: 1) The area around the mixer guard and above the mixer attachment was observed with an accumulation of food debris 2) The stand up fan in the kitchen was observed with an accumulation of dust 3) The ice machine was observed with black residue The non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned as often as necessary to prevent the possible contamination of food. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine and stand up fan have an accumulation of pink residue and dust. New Violation. Correct By: 02/10/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine and fan covers in the walk-in cooler has an accumulation of biofilm. New Violation. Correct By: 01/16/2024
